in_sanskrit.name: Noshad
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God's Grace
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Noshad एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Noshad is derived from the Sanskrit language and is a combination of two words, 'Nos' meaning 'God' and 'Shad' meaning 'Grace'. This name signifies the divine grace bestowed upon an individual by the gods. It is a name that evokes feelings of strength, courage, and power.
